_trn_missing_java_text: For an optimal experience, we suggest letting us take care of Java for you. Only manually manage Java if you know what you're doing, it may result in GDLauncher not working!
_trn_select_required_java_text: Select the required paths to Java. Java 8 is used for all the versions < 1.17
_trn_java_arguments_hint: Separate arguments with spaces. Wrap any path that contains spaces in double quotes, e.g. -javaagent:"C:\Program Files\agent.jar".
_trn_java_description_text: Javas refer to specific java binary paths.
_trn_java_description_local_text: [LOCAL] means that the java is installed in your computer and was automatically detected.
_trn_java_description_managed_text: [MANAGED] means that the java is managed by GDLauncher. You can also install managed versions from the launcher.
_trn_java_description_custom_text: [CUSTOM] means that the java was manually added by you
_trn_profiles_description_text: Profiles are a way to manage java versions and arguments for different instances.
_trn_auto_manage_java_system_profiles_te: If enabled, GDLauncher will automatically manage the system java profiles. If a java profile has no valid java path, it will automatically download it.
_trn_no_available_javas: No Java available for this vendor
_trn_tooltip_valid_path: This java path works and is valid
_trn_tooltip_invalid_path: This java path doesn't seem to work
_trn_runtime_path_text: Select the path where the instances and configuration files will be stored. This is useful if you want to store the instances in a different drive
_trn_instance_settings.prepend_global_ja: Prepend global Java arguments before instance extra Java arguments ({GLOBAL_JAVA_ARGS} below)
_trn_instance_settings.java_override_mis: The selected Java doesn't match the version this instance requires. Minecraft may fail to start; pick a matching Java or turn on automatic Java management.
_trn_profile_used_in_mc_versions: This profile is used in the following Minecraft versions
_trn_confirm_change_runtime_path_text: Are you sure you want to change the runtime path? This will move all your instances and configuration files to the new path.
_trn_confirm_change_runtime_path_already: Are you sure you want to change the runtime path? Since the target folder is already in use, this will simply switch the runtime path configuration and no files will be moved or copied.
_trn_do_not_close_app: Do not close the app. It will restart automatically once it's done.
_trn_do_not_close_app_or_pc_title: Migration in progress: do not close the app or shut down your PC
_trn_do_not_close_app_or_pc_body: Closing the launcher or powering off mid-migration will leave your data split between the old and new locations. The app will restart automatically once it's done.
_trn_migration_errored: Runtime path migration failed. State might be corrupted. Click <0>here</0> for more info on how to proceed.
_trn_migration_stopped: The move stopped before it finished. Nothing was lost. Click <0>here</0> for more info on how to proceed.
_trn_checking_runtime_path: Checking your data folder before moving it...
_trn_saving_copy: Saving the copy to the drive...
_trn_ram_warning_high_allocation: Allocating more than 80% of system RAM may cause Minecraft to crash or system instability.
_trn_insufficient_memory_body: Minecraft is configured to use {{requested}} MB of RAM, and Java needs ~1.5 GB more for its internal operations (about {{needed}} MB total), but only {{available}} MB is currently available. This will likely cause the game to crash.
_trn_show_memory_warning_text: Show a warning before launching when the configured RAM exceeds available memory.
_trn_runtime_recovery.keep_folders: Keep both runtime folders for recovery. Restart uses the saved runtime location.
_trn_runtime_recovery.unresolved: The launcher could not finish stopping the core. Retry this move to finish shutdown safely.
_trn_runtime_recovery.incomplete_target: The new folder {{path}} holds an unfinished move. Delete it or pick another empty folder before you try again. Your data is still in the old folder, and the launcher keeps using it.
_trn_runtime_recovery.copy_removed: GDLauncher removed what this move had copied to {{path}}, so that folder is as it was before. Your data is still in the old folder, and the launcher keeps using it. Fix the problem shown above, for example by freeing up space, then try again.
_trn_runtime_recovery.moved_title: Your data is now in the new folder
_trn_runtime_recovery.left_behind: GDLauncher moved your data to {{newPath}}, but some files stayed in the old folder {{oldPath}}. Once you have dealt with them as described below, you can delete the old folder.
_trn_runtime_recovery.left_changed: These files changed after they were copied, or could not be checked, so the old folder may have a newer version than the new one. If you need it, copy it from the old folder to the same place in the new one before you play: copying it later would overwrite what you played since.
_trn_runtime_recovery.left_not_deleted: These files could not be deleted, for example because another program had them open or you do not have permission to delete them. The new folder has an identical copy, so you can delete them from the old folder.
_trn_runtime_recovery.kept_old_folder: GDLauncher now uses {{newPath}}. When the move finished, it could not confirm that this change was saved to disk, so it deleted nothing from the old folder {{oldPath}}. Check that your instances are in the new folder, then you can delete the old folder to free up space.
_trn_runtime_recovery.not_moved_title: The runtime path was not changed
_trn_runtime_recovery.not_moved_body: Nothing was moved or changed. Your data is still in the current folder, and the launcher keeps using it.
_trn_runtime_recovery.links_inside: GDLauncher can't move these items from your data folder because they are links (symbolic links or junctions) or special files. Replace each link with the real folder or file, or remove it, then try again. You can create the link again after the move.
_trn_runtime_recovery.unavailable_title: Your data folder is not available
_trn_runtime_recovery.unavailable: GDLauncher could not open your data folder {{path}}, so it started with the default folder {{defaultPath}}. Your instances, accounts and settings are still in {{path}}. If that folder is on a drive that is not connected, connect the drive and restart GDLauncher. Until then, anything you change is saved in the default folder.
_trn_runtime_recovery.unavailable_gone: If that folder is gone for good, for example because you no longer have that drive, choose Keep the default folder so this message no longer appears.
_trn_runtime_recovery.keep_default_confi: GDLauncher will keep using the default folder {{defaultPath}} and stop looking for {{path}} when it starts. Nothing in {{path}} is deleted. If you can reach that folder again later, you can switch back to it in Settings > Runtime Path.
_trn_runtime_recovery.keep_default_faile: GDLauncher could not save this choice: {{error}}
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.title: The runtime path can't be changed right now
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.body: Something is still using your data. Close Minecraft, stop your servers and let downloads finish, then try again. Nothing was moved or changed.
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.body_steps: GDLauncher can't be sure that nothing else is using your data, so it won't move it yet. Nothing was moved or changed. Here is what to do:
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.not_started: GDLauncher could not start the move just now. Nothing was moved or changed. Try again in a moment.
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.restart_fai: GDLauncher could not restart right now. Nothing was moved. Close GDLauncher and open it again.
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.server: A local server is running. Stop it
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.install: A download or install is in progress. Let it finish
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.deletion: An instance or server is being deleted. Let it finish
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.task: A launcher task is still running. Wait for it to finish
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.hook: A Pre-Launch or Post-Exit Hook script is still running. Wait for it to finish
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.unconfirmed: A task GDLauncher could not confirm as finished. It may still clear on its own: wait a moment and try again. If it stays, restart GDLauncher
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.previous_ga: Minecraft started before GDLauncher last restarted is still running. Close it
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.previous_pr: A game, server or tool from an earlier session may still be running. If it is Minecraft, close the game normally. If the process with the PID shown below is Java (java, java.exe or javaw.exe) and you are not running a Minecraft server or another Java program yourself, end it in the Details tab of Task Manager, in Activity Monitor or in System Monitor. Otherwise do not end anything: restart your computer instead. Then try again
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.previous_se: This folder belongs to one of your servers. Open that server in the Library instead: its page can stop it, or clear its record if it is no longer running
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.unreadable_: GDLauncher can't read or check the file below, left by a game, server or tool from an earlier session, so it can't tell whether that process is still running. If nothing from that session is still running (restarting your computer makes sure of that), delete this file, then try again
Or start this instance and close Minecraft again: that replaces the file, and GDLauncher removes it when the game closes
Or open this server in the Library and clear its record from its page
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.hidden_file: The file's name starts with a dot, so your file manager may hide it. To show hidden files, press Cmd+Shift+. in Finder or Ctrl+H in most Linux file managers
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.startup_che: GDLauncher is still checking for running games and servers. Wait a few seconds

GDLauncher could not check for games and servers left running from an earlier session. Restart GDLauncher to check again. If this keeps happening, the file or folder named below may be damaged or unreadable
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.shutdown: GDLauncher is closing or restarting. Wait for it to finish, or restart GDLauncher
_trn_runtime_relocation_busy.relocation: Another runtime path change is in progress. Wait for it to finish, or restart GDLauncher
